column2: A first-person drone flight over a misty pine forest at sunrise, the camera gliding steadily forward between the trees, cinematic lighting.
A first-person drone flight over a pine forest during heavy snowfall, thick snowflakes swirling through the air, the trees covered in white snow, cold blue light.
A first-person drone flight over a pine forest at night under a starry sky, bright green aurora borealis glowing above the treetops.
